verdict.rationale: Sift's docs confirm it ships its own Review Queues alongside Workflows, and the console exposes Queues. The founder also notes that most customers have a human review each flagged user. Nothing in the evidence describes what an analyst sees in the queue, so the full-context part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation that queue items show customer history, risk signals and similar or linked cases; evidence of consistency aids such as guided decisions; independent hands-on corroboration of the queue reviewer experience.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently

citations.quote: Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
see all your test data in the console (e.g. Explore, Queues, Workflows, etc.)
Most of our customers review each user we flag, and have a human make a final go/no-go decision about whether to accept the transaction.
